title: System and method for implementing federated learning engine for integration of vertical and horizontal ai

pse.problem: Inefficiency in distributed machine learning and federated learning due to limited data availability at each user environment
pse.solution_function: The system receives a global model from a central aggregator, trains a mini model on local data, uploads the mini model to the central aggregator, receives other mini models, creates a fusion model by combining data and layers from the received mini models, and generates predictions
pse.solution_structure: Memory, at least one processor, global model, mini model, central aggregator, user environments
pse.solution_implementation:
Receiving global model: communication between central aggregator and user environment
Training mini model: processing data with local model
Uploading mini model: stripping classifier head and uploading binary
Receiving mini models: communication between central aggregator and user environment
Creating fusion model: combining layers and weights from received mini models, generating a classifier head, and applying it to layers
Prediction generation: ingesting data, intermediate outputs, and outputting predictions
pse.effect: Improved machine learning model performance by leveraging distributed data and computation resources
